dct_description_sm:
This dataset describes the alignment of the Downtown Historical Railway.

Data currency

The extract for this dataset is updated weekly. There may be no change in data content from one week to the next because there is no change in source data. Priorities and resources will also determine how fast a change in reality is reflected in the database. This data feature rarely if ever changes.

Data accuracy

This data has not been created with survey accuracy.
